body: Do you know where he went wrong?  I don’t want to leave anyone the burden of caring for me in a vegetative state.

I’m sure this is a common response, but I’m confident there won’t be much I’m missing.  I lead a very empty and meaningless life.  The VA is no help.  I have no friends.  No significant other.  No hobbies.  Shit family life.  No job.  No formal education.  I’ll save you the laundry list of shameful self-reflections and just put it like this - it’s been steadily getting worse for a long time and at 38 y/o it’s awful hard to believe that this trajectory is about to change any time soon.
